name: @office/adapter-model
description: Office BIM/model adapter contract (OFF-022): the Autodesk-class model adapter over @office/adapters-sdk — model/model-version/element/element-classification reference mappings (provider ids never primary keys), element change-event mapping into canonical models-area command proposals and event envelopes (delete-of-version retirement, never destructive history deletes), the affected-relationship notification flow (element mutation → canonical event → affected activity/document notifications, typed against the @office/intelligence-relationships vocabulary), and replay-safe multi-stream sync. Generic vocabulary only (adapter kind 'model-cde', system 'model-instance-01'); ports only — no I/O, no SQL, no clock, no randomness; depends only on @office/adapters-sdk, @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, and @office/intelligence-relationships (types only).
